skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic characteristics of international maritime law, legal issues related to international maritime transport contracts, legal significance and common risks in marine cargo insurance activities, and methods for resolving disputes in international maritime transport.

Apply knowledge through reading practical cases, textbooks, and other research materials related to international maritime law. Develop analytical and critical thinking skills through problem-solving exercises.
Develop independent research skills to build and present a topic in class, and select and synthesize materials to solve situational exercises.
Apply knowledge to identify and resolve legal disputes in international maritime transport contracts.
Select and evaluate appropriate legal documents and materials for each chapter of the course to prepare for midterm and final exams.
Actively enhance understanding of international maritime law and critically evaluate legal documents and materials.
